relevance_note: Single case report of a NOD2-positive Blau syndrome patient: "Subsequent gene screening revealed a de novo NOD2 mutation (c.1001G>A, chr16:50744823 p. Arg334Gln)".
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; a short Python script only assembled the JSON. One proband (label 'patient', rule 5) plus three relatives who tested negative for the variant ('absent in his parents and sister'): two parents without stated sex ('parent of patient', 'parent of patient 2') and a sister. Relatives have no variant rows and all-'not reported' checklists. CONTRADICTION: the Case report and Figure 2 legend give c.1001G>A / 'p. Arg334Gln', whereas the Abstract ('a pathogenic p.R334W NOD2 mutation') and Discussion ('pathogenic NOD2 gain-of-function mutation (p.R334W)') give p.R334W; recorded the case-report description (c.1001G>A, p. Arg334Gln) in the variant row and quoted the p.R334W statements only for pathogenicity; p.R334W was not emitted as a second variant. The genomic coordinate chr16:50744823 is printed without a genome build. Figure 2 legend says 'sanger whole genome sequencing (WGS)' (method wording unclear). Functional evidence is not an assay in this paper: the NF-κB statement is cited to ref (5) and refers to the variant the authors call p.R334W. Age 22 years is age at presentation; follow-up continued for six months, so age at last evaluation is approximate. No age at onset stated directly (only 'a 15-year history'); left not reported rather than derived. 'no associated skin changes' was taken as excluding skin rash (it may refer only to skin over the deformed joints). Camptodactyly marked observed from the Figure 1 legend 'Symmetric flexion contractures of bilateral proximal interphalangeal joints 2 to 5' (the word camptodactyly is not used for the patient). Bilateral retinal vasculitis (Figure 1d) recorded as a feature but the checklist vasculitis item (large-vessel arteritis, aortitis or leukocytoclastic vasculitis) left not reported. 'Intraocular pressure was normal' excludes raised IOP only; the composite checklist item 'glaucoma or raised intraocular pressure' left not reported. Minor internal inconsistency: Discussion says partial improvement 'within the first week' vs case report 'within 2 weeks'; Table 1 week-2 CRP 8 vs text CRP <5mg/L 'within two weeks'. Low hemoglobin taken from Table 1 baseline (110 vs normal range 130-175); the text does not name it.
